paite: Aw Israel inkote aw, hiai thu noute suunna ding ka gen za un.
heading: Kisik Ding A Chialna
english: Listen to this word which I take up for a lamentation over you, O house of Israel:

paite: Nungak, Israel, apukta hi; adingh nawn kei ding; agam tung ah paihkhiak ahita; amah tungding ding kuamah a-om kei.
english: “The virgin of Israel has fallen; She shall rise no more. She is cast down on her land; there is no one to raise her up.”

paite: Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: "Israel chite kiang ah, khopi sangkhat pawtna in zakhat anuse ding a, khopi zakhat pawtna in sawmkhat anuse ding hi.”
english: For the Lord Yahweh says: “The city that went out a thousand shall have a hundred left, and that which went out one hundred shall have ten left to the house of Israel.”

paite: TOUPA'N Israel inkote kiang ah hichi in achi:
english: For Yahweh says to the house of Israel: “Seek me, and you will live;

paite: "Hon zong un, na hing ding uh; himahleh Bethel khua zong kei unla, Gilgal ah lut sam kei un, Beer-sheba ah galkah kei unla; pel lou in Gilgal khua sal in aman ding a, Bethel khua ahong vuaksuak ding hi."
english: but don’t seek Bethel, nor enter into Gilgal, and don’t pass to Beersheba; for Gilgal shall surely go into captivity, and Bethel shall come to nothing.

paite: TOUPA zong unla, na hing ding uh; huchi lou in zaw Joseph inn ah mei bang in apawt ding a, akang khin ding a, Bethel ah mitsak ding kuamah a-om kei ding uhi.
english: Seek Yahweh, and you will live, lest he break out like fire in the house of Joseph, and it devour, and there be no one to quench it in Bethel.

paite: Vaihawmna singkha suaksak a, diktatna lei a paikhete aw;
english: You who turn justice to wormwood, and cast down righteousness to the earth!

paite: siguk leh zuheisuktun bawlpa leh sihna limliap lak a tangsakpa leh sun zanmial a bawlpa, tuipi tuite sam a, leitung a luangsakpa, amah tak zong le uchin; amin TOUPA ahi;
english: Seek him who made the Pleiades and Orion, and turns the shadow of death into the morning, and makes the day dark with night; who calls for the waters of the sea, and pours them out on the surface of the earth, Yahweh is his name,

paite: kulh tung a manthatna hong tung guih zou hial a, mihatte tung a manthatna tungsakpa pen.
english: who brings sudden destruction on the strong, so that destruction comes on the fortress.

paite: Kongpi ah taihilhmi amudah ua, thudiktak genmi akih uhi.
heading: Pathian Deih Louh Khohei Gamtat
english: They hate him who reproves in the gate, and they abhor him who speaks blamelessly.

paite: Huaiziak in migentheite tuanden in buh na laksak ua; suangsek in innte na lam ua, himahleh asung ah na teng kei ding uh. Grephuan nuamte na bawl ua, himahleh uain na dawn kei ding uhi.
english: Therefore, because you trample on the poor and take taxes from him of wheat, you have built houses of cut stone, but you will not dwell in them. You have planted pleasant vineyards, but you shall not drink their wine.

paite: Na tatleknate uh tamdan leh na khelhnate uh athupidan lah ka thei ngal a; midiktatte na simmoh ua, golhna la a, kongpi a tasamte ahih ding him ua pampaihte aw.
english: For I know how many are your offenses, and how great are your sins— you who afflict the just, who take a bribe, and who turn away the needy in the courts.

paite: Huchi in hun hoih lou ahih ziak in mipil zaw huai hun chiang in adai dide ding hi.
english: Therefore a prudent person keeps silent in such a time, for it is an evil time.

paite: Na hintheihna ding un hoihlouhna zong lou in, hoihna zong unla; huan na gen bang un, TOUPA sepaihte' Pathian na kiang uah a-om ding hi.
english: Seek good, and not evil, that you may live; and so Yahweh, the God of Armies, will be with you, as you say.

paite: Khelhna hua unla, hoihna it un; kongpi ah vaihawmna kiptak in tungding un; Joseph inkuan akhosuaksunte tung ah TOUPA, sepaihte' Pathian in hehpihna anei kha mai ding hi.
english: Hate evil, love good, and establish justice in the courts. It may be that Yahweh, the God of Armies, will be gracious to the remnant of Joseph.”

paite: Huaiziak in TOUPA, sepaihte' Pathian, Toupa'n hichi in achi: "Kongzing teng ah nakpi a kahna a-om ding a, lamliante tengteng ah, khawk hi na mah e; achi ding uh; lungkham ding in lounei mite leh nakpi a kap ding in sisuun siamte asam ding uhi.
english: Therefore Yahweh, the God of Armies, the Lord, says: “Wailing will be in all the wide ways. They will say in all the streets, ‘Alas! Alas!’ They will call the farmer to mourning, and those who are skillful in lamentation to wailing.

paite: Grephuan teng ah nakpi a kahna a-om ding a; na lak uah ka paisuak ding," TOUPA'N achi.
english: In all vineyards there will be wailing, for I will pass through the middle of you,” says Yahweh.

paite: TOUPA ni deihte aw, na tung uh agik hi! Bangziak a TOUPA ni deih na hia ua? Vak hilou in mial ahi zaw hi.
english: “Woe to you who desire the day of Yahweh! Why do you long for the day of Yahweh? It is darkness, and not light.

paite: Humpinelkai taisan a, vompi tuak mi bang leh inn a lut a, baang tung a khut nga a gul in atuk bang ahi.
english: As if a man fled from a lion, and a bear met him; or he went into the house and leaned his hand on the wall, and a snake bit him.

paite: TOUPA ni vak hilou in mial ahi sin kei a hia? Mial sah leh vakna nei lou in?
english: Won’t the day of Yahweh be darkness, and not light? Even very dark, and no brightness in it?

paite: "Na ankuangluite uh ka hua in ka musit a, na kikhawmpi pisuakte uah leng ka kipak sam kei hi.
english: I hate, I despise your feasts, and I can’t stand your solemn assemblies.

paite: Ahi, na thillat uleh na buh lat uh hon lan mah le uchin, ka sang kei ding, na gan thau uh lemna thillatte leng ka limsak sam kei ding hi.
english: Yes, though you offer me your burnt offerings and meal offerings, I will not accept them; neither will I regard the peace offerings of your fat animals.

paite: Na kaihging ging kilawm uh ka ngaikhe kei ding; huaiziak in kei a kipan bil aphuai na late uh lamang un.
english: Take away from me the noise of your songs! I will not listen to the music of your harps.

paite: Himahleh vaihawmna bel tuite bang in leh diktatna lui lian bang in luang hen," TOUPA'N achi.
english: But let justice roll on like rivers, and righteousness like a mighty stream.

paite: "Aw Israel inkote aw, kum sawmli sung in gamdai ah kithoihnate leh thillatte ka kiang ah na hon lan ngei ua hia?
english: “Did you bring to me sacrifices and offerings in the wilderness forty years, house of Israel?

paite: Ahi, na milim uh Molok leh na milimte uh Kaiuan, na aksi pathian uh, noute ding in na tawisang zaw uhi.
english: You also carried the tent of your king and the shrine of your images, the star of your god, which you made for yourselves.

paite: TOUPA amin sepaihte' Pathian in, noute Damaskas kho khen ah sal in ka hon paisak ding," TOUPA'N achi.
english: Therefore I will cause you to go into captivity beyond Damascus,” says Yahweh, whose name is the God of Armies.
